name: India Cements Capital Limited
about: India Cements Capital Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides money changing services in India. It offers For X Change, a money changing service for foreign exchange, money transfer, travel insurance, currency converter, forex rates, and AD-II services; and advisory services for the on the forex market to exporters and importers under the Midas Advisory brand name. The company is also involved in share broking activities; and provision of travel related services, including ticketing, hotel bookings, and visa processing. India Cements Capital Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.
